newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish external reserves up by 68mln punts in March.
newsitem.headline: Irish external reserves up by 68mln punts in March.

text.p: Ireland's official external reserves rose by 68 million Irish pounds to just under 5.9 billion at the end of March, central bank monthly statistics showed on Thursday.
EU receipts and Exchequer foreign borrowing were the main factors contributing to this increase, the bank said in a statement.
In addition, a valuation adjustment resulted in a write-up in the Irish pound value of the reserves amounting to 22 million.
